sprint.note: While `node orch.mjs sprint` runs for ONE tool (runbook 'Sprint mode', the owner 2026-10-28): up to 6 agents at once, 12 review agents, and Opus agents 3 (simple tool) or 4 (complex tool) instead of the default 2 below. No review is dropped; the extra agents run the looks in parallel. Everything else in `defaults` still applies, and it ends with `sprint stop`.

tiers.tier2: full check only for changed tools
tiers.tier3: real-input play test for new or risky interactions
tiers.tier4: review pack only for visual changes
